newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KorAm Bank to buy Hanmi Lease shares.
newsitem.headline: KorAm Bank to buy Hanmi Lease shares.

text.p: KorAm Bank will buy a 20.98 percent stake, or 2.4 million shares, of Hanmi Lease Co Ltd through a tender offer, a bank official said on Tuesday.

The official said the purchase would take place over 20 days starting from March 31. KorAm Bank plans to buy Hanmi's stock at 12,000 won per share. The purchase would bring KorAm's stake in Hanmi Lease to 40 percent.
Hanmi shares closed on Tuesday 300 won lower at 10,500.
"We want to be prepared to block any hostile take-over bid by securing a controlling stake in Hanmi," he said.
A small trading company is the second largest shareholder with a 12.35 percent stake.
